agreed: Owner, 18 November 2026: SIX SERVICES UPDATE (master blueprint section 69, 69.3 LynkHR, 69.11 further improvements, 69.12 rules). Built in build section 4B. Prices locked in section 4 part 1b (v0.49.0).
rule: LynkHR's rules, read only through core/hr.py and ts/src/hr.ts (python3 tools/hr_vectors.py after a change). LynkAssist never decides hiring, pay, promotion, discipline or dismissal and never scores a person; a named person decides and the person affected can ask for a human review. Health, family, union and similar details are kept only where the law allows, seen by the fewest roles and never used in reports about a person. A staff member can always see their own record and ask for a correction. Staff data is never sold and never shown outside without the person's consent. Payroll runs in LynkAcc: LynkHR sends figures only. Days of leave are counted in half days (whole numbers); money is integer minor units. A country's own rule comes from its pack (office.hr); while unknown, the safe default here applies.
workers_rule: Every kind of worker has a record; volunteers and contractors are never put on payroll (they are paid, if at all, through LynkAcc bills).

fields.special_rule: A special detail is kept only where the country pack allows it (office.hr.special_allowed); while unknown it is not kept. It is never in a report about a person.
fields.self_rule: The person always sees their own record (never another person's case notes about them until the case is closed) and can ask for a correction.

leave.default_rule: Until the country pack confirms its legal minimum (office.hr.leave_half_days), the organisation sets its own entitlement and LynkHR shows the minimum as unknown; it never invents a legal number. Unpaid leave and public holidays have no balance.
leave.clash_rule: A request is shown as a clash when it would leave more than the team's share away on any day (owner may lower the share); a clash is shown, never a refusal.
leave.approval: The person who asks never approves their own leave; their manager or the next person up does.
leave.patterns_rule: Absence patterns are shown to the manager as counts only, never as a score, a ranking or a judgment.

checklists.rule: Final pay figures go to LynkAcc only after notice is recorded, equipment is back and access is closed. An optional step is never blocking.

expiry.rule: A reminder goes at each step before an expiry date to the person and to HR; an expired document is shown as expired, never hidden, and nothing is blocked automatically.

reviews.rule: Peer and upward answers are shown only when at least 3 people answered, and never with names. LynkAssist may summarise a review, labelled a draft; a person writes and signs the final review.
reviews.school: Schools (SCHOOL UPDATE 80.15): a lesson observation is a review by a named observer that the teacher always sees, never anonymous; the yearly appraisal is the manager review; a teaching licence is reminded like every expiring document.

pay.rule: A pay change needs approval by a different person than the one who proposed it; a pay review stays inside its budget or needs a second approver. Advances and loans are recorded for payroll only; any real lending is by a licensed partner. Commission comes from LynkPOS figures.

overtime.rule: Minutes above the weekly threshold are overtime, paid at the multiplier or taken as time off in lieu; the organisation's agreements and the country pack may change both numbers.

cases.rule: Cases are seen only by HR and the named investigator (the owner only when named); every step has a deadline; a decision is always a named person's, with a right of appeal. The anonymous concern line never records who raised it. Help-desk questions are answered from the handbook first and stay tracked cases.

assist.rule: LynkAssist drafts and explains; every suggestion is labelled; it never decides about a person.

headcount_rule: A plan's positions and their yearly cost are compared with the budget; a plan over budget is shown, never blocked.
